messages.content:
Luca (customer care assistant): Linen and Paper, this is Luca. How can I help?
Henrik (customer): Hi, Henrik Olsen. I ordered a tote bag last Wednesday and it still hasn't shipped. I don't want it any more: please cancel it and give me my money back.
Luca (customer care assistant): I'm sorry. Let me check, and I'll email you today.
Henrik (customer): Thanks.

seller_records.return_policy: returns accepted within 14 days; refund within 5 days of receiving the return
seller_records.listing_text: Linen tote bag, natural (undyed, oatmeal colour), 40x38 cm.

inquiry.summary: Phone call: says it never arrived
